meme_name: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic
text: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic is a Canadian /American flash cartoon series, produced by Studio B Productions (now rebranded DHX), based on the My Little Pony universe. It was developed for television by Lauren Faust , who also did major work on both The Powerpuff Girls and Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends . Since its on-air debut in October 2010, the series has become extremely popular across the Internet by gathering a massive online following. Fans outside the show's target demographic, especially teen and adult male fans, have come to be known as "bronies" . Female fans of the show may also be referred to as "pegasisters" .
